people.name: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
people.field: Indologist and noted scholar of Sanskrit

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: From 1967 to 2004, he held the Chair of Sanskrit at the École pratique des hautes études and later became Emeritus Professor.

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: Filliozat was the son of esteemed Indologist Jean Filliozat

relations.subject: Jean Filliozat
relations.evidence: Jean Filliozat, founder of the French Institute of Pondicherry.

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: Between 1963 and 1967, Filliozat worked with the École française d'Extrême-Orient in Pondicherry.

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: he was elected to the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles‑Lettres (President in 2010)

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: served as Vice-President of the Société Asiatique (2000–2019).

relations.subject: Pierre-Sylvain Filliozat
relations.evidence: He was married to Karnataka-born art historian Vasundhara Kavali Filliozat.
